tagline: UFP Industries, Inc. is a holding company with subsidiaries throughout the United States, Mexico, Canada, Spain, India and Australia that design, manufacture and supply products made from wood, wood and non-wood composites, and other materials to three segments: retail, packaging, and construction.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Construction segment represents a significant portion of the company's revenue and is a key driver of its overall performance, with unit stability in 2025 despite a challenging market environment.

kpis.name: Construction Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's construction activities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures sales from the Construction segment, which is one of the company's primary end markets.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of demand in the construction sector.

kpis.name: Retail Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's retail operations.
kpis.description: This KPI represents sales from the Retail segment, which serves end consumers.
kpis.signal: Reflects performance in the retail market.

kpis.name: Packaging Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's packaging activities.
kpis.description: This KPI measures sales from the Packaging segment, which provides packaging products to various industries.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin measures the efficiency of production and raw material cost management.
kpis.signal: Indicator of product and service profitability.

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs associated with sales, marketing, administration and general operations.
kpis.description: These expenses reflect operating costs not directly tied to production.
kpis.signal: Measure of operational efficiency and investments in growth.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in long-term assets such as plants and equipment.
kpis.description: Capex is essential to maintain and expand the company's production capacity and infrastructure.
kpis.signal: Indicates investments in capacity and operational improvements.

kpis.name: Average Lumber Price
kpis.explanation: Average composite lumber price, a key raw material cost for the company.
kpis.description: Fluctuations in lumber prices directly affect production costs and sales levels.
kpis.signal: Direct impact on raw material costs and pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Lumber Cost as a Percentage of Sales
kpis.explanation: Percentage of net sales represented by lumber cost.
kpis.description: This ratio shows the significance of lumber cost within the company's cost structure.
kpis.signal: Indicator of profitability sensitivity to raw material costs.

kpis.name: Acquisition of Berry Pallets
kpis.explanation: Announcement of the acquisition of operating assets of Berry Pallets, a pallet manufacturer.
kpis.description: This acquisition aims to strengthen the company's position in the packaging market and expand its capacity.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion in the pallet manufacturing sector.

risks.title: Economic Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Global and national macroeconomic pressures, uncertainty regarding future interest rates, fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates

risks.title: Lumber Market Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Significant fluctuations in wood product costs, impact on sales and earnings

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: Information system vulnerabilities, risks of hacking, viruses and security breaches

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Customer concentration among two major clients, risk of market share loss

risks.title: Environmental and Safety Risks
risks.score_rationale: Environmental and safety risks related to company operations, impact on financial results

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and Inflation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Foreign exchange and inflation risks related to the company's international operations

risks.title: Litigation and Liability Risks
risks.score_rationale: Litigation and liability risks related to company operations

ai_positioning.summary: UFP Industries Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its filed report.
